title: Point Seven Stack Receive (Michelle Grogan)
style: fast phonk progressive trance fusion 134bpm heavy bongo conga djembe slap bass spanish guitar pads synth lead trance buildup tribal claps English Spanish coach calls
lyrics:
[Intro umpire voice]
Server is a lefty
Partner is a righty
Stack is the formation
Forehands center always

[Verse 1 commentary]
Server stands left side of court
Partner stands left side too
After contact partner slides right
Forehands meet in the middle view
Vamos vamos forehand center
Uno dos tres formation enter
Stack works for the lefty side
Keeps the strong side cover wide

[Pre-Chorus]
Stack stack
Forehands center
Stack stack
Formation enter

[Chorus]
Point seven stack receive point seven stack receive
Forehands center forehands center
Point seven stack receive point seven stack receive
Vamos amigos formation enter

[Verse 2 coaching]
Why stack on receive
Because weak side is hidden
Forehand cover the middle ball
Two strong sides on the call
Uno dos tres slide and shift
Mano firme paddle lift
After return slide to position
Kitchen line in transition

[Bridge]
Not every team needs to stack
Only when one side is the strong track
Lefty righty pairs always stack
Two righties only sometimes flack

[Chorus]
Point seven stack receive point seven stack receive
Forehands center forehands center
Point seven stack receive point seven stack receive
Vamos amigos formation enter

[Outro]
Stack stack
Forehands center
Stack stack
Formation enter
